dmf.scan_components read only settings.extraction_dir, so a body from another extraction could be scanned against the previous hero's folder and vmdl.

scan_components derives the extraction and vmdl from the imported body, ignoring a stale saved extraction outside that body.
stage refuses to register the primary body as a component body-group choice.
